Mark starts with $50 in his bank account and earns $10 per day. To buy a bike that costs $300, he needs an additional amount of money, which is $300 - $50 = $250. Since he earns $10 per day, the number of days he needs to work to save the remaining amount is $250 ÷ $10 = 25 days.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 25
